dosage_or_directions_for_use: Clean the wound and dry the surrounding skin. Hold the Tata 1mg Medicated First Aid Dressing by the protective strips with the pad side facing down. Place the pad on the wound, conveniently peel away the strips uniformly and press the sticky edges of the dressing down on the skin. For best results, change the dressing daily until wound is healed.
